set.nameZh: 概率的取值范围与概率的性质

set.reason: Knowing probabilities lie in [0,1] and the certain event has probability one helps check sums. Applying disjoint addition, however, does not strictly need these bounds.
set.scope: sanity checks and total probability one

set.reason: The source defines a nonzero consecutive-term quotient. The new series uses power-form terms, including a=0 or r=0 where that quotient is unavailable. Nonzero geometric sequences are useful preparation, but the source quotient-based definition is not a universal prerequisite for the broader series scope.
set.scope: identifying geometric progression structure and common ratio

set.reason: Taking the limit of the finite sum is the standard derivation and supports the convergence check. Applying a/(1-r) under |r|<1 can also be justified by self-similarity S=a+rS once convergence is known.
set.scope: deriving the limiting sum formula

set.reason: Splitting by the next transition and weighting conditional probabilities is the total probability formula. Pure counting recursions instead add counts of disjoint cases, with no probability involved.
set.scope: first-step conditioning for probability targets

criteria: Identify the first term and common ratio.
Check convergence and compute an infinite sum.
set.description: For real r with |r|<1, the infinite series a+ar+ar^2+... converges to a/(1-r); check convergence before using this sum.
set.name: Convergent infinite geometric series

criteria: 能判断两个事件是否互斥
能计算互斥事件的并的概率
set.description: 会用互斥事件的加法：P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B)。也会用容斥处理不互斥的情形。
set.name: Addition of Probabilities

criteria: 能计算 n 次独立都发生的概率
能用对立事件求至少一次
set.description: 会计算多次独立重复中「都发生」或「至少一次」的概率。条件概率不在必修范围。
set.name: Probability Calculations for Independent Events

criteria: Justify what history the state must retain and the relevant initial or absorbing conditions.
Combine transitions correctly for the chosen count, probability, or expectation target, including per-step cost for waiting times.
For an infinite-horizon expected waiting time, justify finiteness or the intended minimal nonnegative solution; do not infer it from formal recurrence algebra alone.
set.description: Choose states retaining the information needed for the next step. Construct count or probability recurrences, or first-step equations for expected remaining cost/waiting time with transition probabilities and per-step cost. Apply initial or absorbing conditions. For an infinite-horizon expectation, justify finiteness or establish the intended minimal nonnegative solution before treating a solved linear system as the expectation.
set.name: Counts, probabilities, and expected waiting times by state recursion
set.nameZh: 状态递推计数、概率与期望等待时间

criteria: 能把样本分成互斥的几类
能计算全概率
set.description: 若几种原因互斥且覆盖全部可能，事件的概率等于各原因的概率乘以相应条件概率后再相加。
set.name: Law of Total Probability

criteria: 能选择便于代入的方程
能正确求出方程组的解
set.description: 把一个方程变形用一个未知数表示另一个，代入另一个方程消元，转化为一元一次方程。
set.name: Elimination by Substitution

criteria: 能判断一个数列是不是等比数列
能求出公比
set.description: 从第 2 项起，每一项与前一项的比都等于同一个非零常数，这个数列就是等比数列，常数叫做公比。
set.name: The concept of geometric sequences

criteria: 能用公比不等于 1 的求和公式

set.description: 公比 q≠1 时，S_n=a1(q^n−1)/(q−1)。q=1 时，S_n=na1。
set.name: The sum of the first n terms of a geometric sequence
